text:
taylor: Heads up — hit a pretty confusing failure in the embeddings -> rerank pipeline while onboarding a customer. looks like a few DX surfaces went wrong at once.
nina: short summary?
taylor: user runs our examples to build an ANN index. they used `examples/embeddings/batch_helper.js` to create vectors and then `examples/rerank/demo.js` to score. rerank returned a vague error: `vectors.length !== candidates.length` and the app crashed.
omar: that usually means the helper returned a flattened list. can you paste the helper output shape?
taylor: yep. helper logged: `vectors.length = 3072` but candidates.length = 2. debug shows model was `open-embed-small` (dims=1024). user passed 3 texts, expected shape [3,1024] but we stored and returned a flat array [3072].
nina: ohoy. so two problems: helper flattens for cache storage, and sample rerank code assumes nested arrays.
taylor: exactly. plus another twist: the user had intermittent 429s from embeddings endpoint during ingestion. our helper retried but wrote partial arrays into the cache on each attempt. final cached value was a concatenation of partial chunks (length 3072) even though candidate list for rerank was length 2. messy.
omar: yikes. sounds like we need three fixes: (1) batch helper always returns nested arrays (no implicit flat), (2) cache write is atomic and only after full batch completes, (3) add a dim-check when calling rerank to surface clear errors.
nina: propose the runtime error message be explicit: `EmbeddingDimensionMismatch: expected=1024 actual=1536 for candidate index=1. Check that embeddings and rerank use the same model.`
taylor: also add a lint/CI test in examples that runs `npm run examples:smoke` and validates dims across example files so copy-paste doesn't produce silent mismatch.
omar: good. also for retry behavior: ensure the helper uses an idempotency key per batch and writes to cache with a temp key then renames the key atomically. ops also wants a metric on partial-cache-writes for a couple of weeks to see how often this happens.
ci-bot: opened issue #3498: "examples: embedding batch helper - stop flattening, make cache writes atomic, and validate dims in rerank". Assigned to @taylor and @nina.
taylor: I'll send a small PR to examples and a separate PR to sdk.rerank to add the explicit dim validation and error class.
omar: add a short entry in the onboarding doc: "If you mix embed models (small vs large), you'll get size/dim errors. Always check `model.dimensions` or use `sdk.embeddings.modelInfo()` before building index".
nina: can we ship a quick CLI `scripts/check-embeddings.js` that loads an index and reports dims mismatch? customers could run it during migration.
taylor: yep. I'll add it under `examples/tools/` and a tiny README note.
ci-bot: tagged patch release note candidate: "fix(examples): avoid flattening batch helper; add dim mismatch checks and atomic cache writes"
taylor: thanks. anything else?
omar: add unit test that simulates 429 partial responses and assert cache key only updated after full response.
taylor: will do. closing for now
